header.title: AI Agents (Vacademy AI)
header.description: Author the personas our own AI caller speaks with — the prompt, opening line, language, voice and what to find out. Saving an agent automatically registers it under Campaigns / Agents above, so workflows and the IVR can pick it by name.

empty: No agents yet. Create one — e.g. an “Admissions Qualifier” that greets new leads and finds out the student’s class and course interest.

voice.label: Voice
voice.genderHint: The bot matches its Hindi grammar (kar rahi/raha hoon) to the voice's gender automatically.

speakingPace.label: Speaking pace
speakingPace.hint: 0.5–2.0. 1.0–1.1 suits sales calls; above 1.2 starts to sound rushed.
speakingPace.rumikHint: Rumik has no numeric speed control, so this steers its delivery in words — the average pace lands where you set it, but individual sentences vary a little.

expressivenessField.label: Expressiveness
expressivenessField.hint: How much the voice varies its intonation and emotion.

voiceModulation.label: Voice modulation
voiceModulation.hint: How much the pitch rises and falls. Applied to the audio itself, so it works with every voice and engine — a flat, read-out tone becomes conversational.

voiceTester.label: Test this voice
voiceTester.hint: Speaks the sample with the selected voice, pace and expressiveness — change the voice above and play again to compare. Phone calls sound slightly warmer/narrower than this (telephony is 8 kHz audio).

openingLine.label: Opening line
openingLine.placeholder: What the agent says the moment the call connects…

systemPrompt.label: System prompt
systemPrompt.placeholder: Who the agent is, its goal, tone, and rules…

extractionQuestions.label: Questions to find out (one per line)
extractionQuestions.placeholder:
What class is the student in?
Which course are they interested in?

handoffNumbers.label: Handoff numbers (comma separated)
handoffNumbers.placeholder: +9198xxxxxxxx — who gets the call when the caller asks for a human
handoffNumbers.hint: Blank = the voicemail/fallback number from Calling settings.

bookingPage.label: Auto-book meetings on
bookingPage.audienceSuffix: · adds lead to its audience list
bookingPage.hint: When a call agrees on a demo/visit time, a meeting is booked on this page (Google Meet link + reminders sent). If the page is linked to an audience list, the lead is added there too.
bookingPage.hintNoPages: Create a booking page first in CRM → Meetings → Share Booking Link.
